title: The Stringer Bound Conjecture: Proofs, Computations, and Exact Certificates
description: A certificate-backed investigation of finite-sample conservatism for the Stringer monetary-unit-sampling bound. This release includes a proof for n = 2 at every confidence level, exact rational counterexamples at low confidence, a documented gap in the strongest prior finite-sample certification, reproducible search and certification code, and machine-checkable certificates.
